selected_source_files.classification: Prompt startup splits into prepare and start. _startRun sets _isAgentRunActive before _prepareRun, and _handleAgentEvent calls agent.abort() on agent_start when _agentRunAbortRequested is set. The selected adapter sends abort while waiting for the prompt response; prompt success is only emitted after prep, so a consumer cancel can land inside preparation. The selected startup window includes prompt-image normalization for the selected single PNG and tool-loadout preparation. This is a fix that makes the already-mapped abort apply during that window: 1.1.0 dropped an abort requested during prep; 1.2.0+ aborts at agent_start and settles aborted. PromptDisposition stays handled, queued, or started; steering and follow-up stay handled or queued; agent_settled.aborted stays a required boolean. dist/modes/rpc is byte-identical. --no-extensions still skips extension-triggered custom-message handlers; those handlers are not the selected abort path.
